patch_description:
Replace the current ansatz (which emphasized CCRZ line motifs) with the seed-style block that mixes ZZZ winning-line motifs and CCRZ center/diagonal correlations, together with symmetry-grouped local rotations and compact final rotations. The seed-style configuration previously produced better validation/test accuracy in this task; restoring those motifs aligns three-qubit interactions explicitly with winning lines (ZZZ) while keeping high-order CCRZ correlations for center/diagonal structure. Parameter sharing across symmetric zones keeps parameter efficiency high.

This edit only changes ANSATZ_SPEC inside the allowed EVOLVE region.
